children.value: > Fact From Story One of the biggest disruptors to our sleep is when UK clocks go forward one hour at 1am on the last Sunday in March and go back one hour at 2am on the last Sunday in October, which is rapidly approaching on 30 October.
> > Fact From Story Winter is coming, as the clocks go backwards one hour at 2am on Sunday 29 October. | Deduced Fact
> > > Fact From Story One of the biggest disruptors to our sleep is when UK clocks go forward one hour at 1am on the last Sunday in March.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge March is before October in the year.
> > Commonsense Knowledge October 29th is the last Sunday in October. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Commonsense Knowledge The last Sunday in October 2023 is October 29th, 2023.
